Newspapers Sue OpenAI and Microsoft for Copyright Infringement

The Seattle Times and Newsday have filed a lawsuit against OpenAI and Microsoft, alleging copyright infringement. The newspapers claim that the tech companies copied their journalism without permission to train their artificial intelligence systems. The suit was filed in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York. A spokesperson for OpenAI stated that the company is committed to working with publishers and respects their rights.
